stresses: one sitting emits 10 findings; triage bounds; tray depth stays sane
description: The Jun 26-27 deep-dive day as one marathon sitting: the mechanism battery (F19-F24, F26) salted with the onset post-mortem (F33), the shift-log review (F34), and the log-spam tangential (F36), so triage - not just throughput - is stressed. Routine drafts must batch, decisions must stay one-by-one, the salt must route to notes/sediment rather than the causal narrative, and narrative growth must stay far below the finding count - but not at zero: the mechanism section must actually grow. Scenario end implies attention lapse: the marathon sitting parks and files, which is what clears the held excerpt.

Q2's mechanism section exists and grew from this sitting - citing F19, F21, F22, F24, F26 - with the F24 causal-claim draft (from t=34) pending, and the onset revision (F20 over F03) landed as an addendum; a route-everything-to-sediment policy fails this
